item.title: Kazakhstan court orders curbs on Coinbase, BingX and four others
item.description: Nine other crypto platforms voluntarily restricted app access in Kazakhstan, prompting the regulator to withdraw its claims against them.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin

item.title: XRP 30-day exchange inflows pass 6B tokens as whales move to the sidelines
item.description: More than 6 billion XRP reached exchanges tracked by CryptoQuant in the 30 days to Oct. 19, the most since March.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Mt. Gox pushes creditor repayment deadline to 2027 in sixth extension
item.description: Mt. Gox extended its repayment deadline by another year as some creditors remain unpaid due to incomplete procedures and payment processing issues.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitget plans Thai crypto exchange acquisition weeks after $388M hack
item.description: The proposed acquisition would give Bitget a route into Thailand’s crypto market through a locally licensed operator.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
item.description: JPMorgan included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market outlook for the first time but warned that volatility and unstable correlations limit its role in investment portfolios.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
item.description: BlackRock’s proposed Bitcoin fund would use options to limit potential losses and gains, adding another strategy to its existing Bitcoin and Ether ETF lineup.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
item.description: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Sophon sets Nov. 25 withdrawal deadline ahead of mainnet shutdown
item.description: In June, Sophon’s developers said the costs of maintaining a standalone blockchain no longer justified its benefits and announced plans to focus on consumer finance and AI applications on Base.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
item.description: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
item.description: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
item.description: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
item.description: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
item.description: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
item.description: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
item.description: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
item.description: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
item.description: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
item.description: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
item.description: Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
item.description: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
item.description: Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
item.description: Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
item.description: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: BingX, YouHodler added to ESMA MiCA register in latest update
item.description: ESMA’s latest MiCA register update includes BingX, YouHodler and Banco Santander’s Openbank, bringing the total to 375 unique CASPs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
item.description: France’s National Assembly adopted a crypto tax amendment targeting certain stablecoin swaps, while separate proposals on exit taxes and self-custodial wallet reporting remain under consideration.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Stocks rebound into key tech earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Analysts expect Bitcoin to retest $80,000 support again as stock markets attempt to recover last week’s losses.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
item.description: JPMorgan is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
item.description: US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
item.description: Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
